scope: isolated simplified RTE research implementation; production defaults unchanged
training_loss: K * mean((Y - R P - X Q)^2)
normalization: reuse frozen parent training-only K=f0_MAE/f0_MSE and reference=f0_MAE
rnj_role: initial hierarchy and provided warm-family supports supply candidates/warm starts only
initial_family: singleton/full basis and explicit hard priors
tail_domain: all complete-subtree frontiers with at most block_limit blocks; pool their proper nontrivial unions
tail_trigger: maximum current direct child-block count <= block_limit
exit_pool: RNJ/warm supports + accepted own-path supports + T pool + all terminal pairs + basis/hard
secondary_validation_metric: MSE on the identical fitted library
validation_candidates: raw accepted own path (initialized with singleton/full) and singleton-only baseline; no contraction/refit mapping
inherited_preprocessing_note: RNJ geometry, its historical preprocessing/contraction and parent common computation remain frozen and are disclosed; the complete upstream pipeline is not claimed parameter-free
